description: Header file defining interfaces, classes, and data structures for transaction completion listener in Android's graphics system, including callback IDs, surface stats, transaction stats, and listener callback management.

classes.name: CallbackId
classes.description: Represents a callback identifier with type and optional jank data inclusion flag.

classes.name: ReleaseCallbackId
classes.description: Identifies a buffer release callback with buffer ID and frame number.

classes.name: FrameEventHistoryStats
classes.description: Stores statistics about frame events, including fences and timing.

classes.name: JankData
classes.description: Contains information about surface flinger jank classification for frames.

classes.name: SurfaceStats
classes.description: Holds statistics related to a surface, including acquire times, fences, and jank data.

classes.name: TransactionStats
classes.description: Aggregates callback IDs, timing, fences, and surface stats for a transaction.

classes.name: ListenerStats
classes.description: Holds listener reference and associated transaction stats.

classes.name: ITransactionCompletedListener
classes.description: Interface for transaction completion callbacks, including methods for completion, buffer release, queue stalls, and presentation changes.

classes.name: BnTransactionCompletedListener
classes.description: Binder interface implementation for transaction completed listener.

classes.name: ListenerCallbacks
classes.description: Manages callback registration and filtering for a listener.

methods.name: onTransactionCompleted
methods.description: Called when a transaction is completed, providing transaction stats.

methods.name: onReleaseBuffer
methods.description: Called when a buffer is released, with callback ID, fence, and buffer count.

methods.name: onTransactionQueueStalled
methods.description: Called when a transaction queue stalls.

methods.name: onTrustedPresentationChanged
methods.description: Notifies change in trusted presentation state.

methods.name: onTransact
methods.description: Handles IPC transactions for the binder interface.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters listener callbacks by callback ID type.
